title: Kids + Adolescents Research Learning On Tablet Teaching Aachen in children and adolescents with diabetes mellitus type 1 - a multicentre, randomised study
summary:
The aim of the DIA-KARLOTTA 2.0 study plan is to implement a digital learning game for German-speaking countries to test the specific knowledge about type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1D) of our paediatric patients in an age-appropriate and interesting digital game environment, and to address gaps in disease-specific knowledge in the subsequent contact with the doctor. The quiz is to be combined with a game and can be completed by patients while they are waiting for their doctor's appointment in the outpatient clinic. The individual and customised advice and the preceding discussion of the quiz questions are intended to promote a better understanding of the disease.
The application is intended to improve specific knowledge, understanding of the disease, adherence to therapy and self-efficacy in terms of dealing with the disease on one's own responsibility. In particular for the group of older adolescents, the readiness for the transition to adult medicine can be recorded and processed. 

A multicentre, randomised, controlled study with 150 paediatric T1D patients will be conducted to test the applicability . Our hypothesis is that the additional playing of the tablet T1D quiz and the individualised counselling will have a positive effect on T1D knowledge, disease activity and T1D-related therapy satisfaction/quality of life.

At the same time, a focus group will examine the comprehensibility and difficulty of the individual knowledge questions among 50 paediatric T1D patients, 15 parents, 3 diabetes counsellors and 3 diabetologists. The aim here is to test the hypothesis of determining the difficulty and comprehensibility of individual knowledge questions in different age groups in order to specifically improve the applicability of the questionnaire in everyday clinical practice.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. female and male children, adolescents and young adults
    adults aged 8-21 years
2. diagnosis of diabetes mellitus type 1
3. informed consent and signed declaration of consent
4. patients must be able to read and write German (French for parts of the focus group)
5. patients must be able to play independently on the tablet
Exclusion criteria:
1. age < 8 years or> 21 years
2. illiteracy
3. mental or psychomotor disability
